supporting_passages: Windward Islands Luxury Yachting Itinerary | YachtLife
Below is a sample 7-day yachting itinerary in Windward Islands. Enjoy.
Board your yacht in Castries, the capital city of St. Lucia, and cruise to nearby Marigot... After lunch in the bay, head to the twin volcanic peaks of Pitons
Depart at dawn cruise to the island of Bequia... perfect for snorkeling, diving and other water sports
After a relaxing morning in Bequia, depart for the volcanic Union Island... white sandy beaches underneath idyllic palms
Take a short cruise to Tabago Cays... With its pristine shorelines, the islands boasts superb snorkeling and some of the finest diving in the Caribbean
Depart midmorning for Mustique... Horseback riding and hiking trails are abundant on the island
Depart at noon to Young Island > the perfect place to leave the world behind... You’ll be able to have the beaches to yourselves
Depart Young Island and cruise up the beautiful coast of Saint Vincent back to the St. Lucia. Make your way on land to visit the Soufrière volcano before returning to port in St. Lucia
title: Windward Islands 7-Day Yachting Itinerary
